metadata.title: High-Performance Computing Data Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and appropriate use of data processed and produced by shared high-performance computing platforms.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: HPC shared filesystems, scratch storage, burst buffers, high-throughput data paths, and research data repositories.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Governs data protection, lifecycle control, and access boundaries in high‑performance computing environments.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: HPC data protection assumes foundational trust in shared compute platforms.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Data protection depends on correct attribution and authorization of HPC users and jobs.

metadata.remarks: High‑Performance Computing Data Protection defines trust properties required to protect data in shared, performance‑oriented computing environments. This pattern makes data access boundaries, lifecycle risks, and high‑volume data movement explicit, recognizing that HPC platforms prioritize throughput, collaboration, and scale over default data isolation.

components.title: Shared Storage Access Control
components.description: Controls access to shared HPC filesystems and data repositories.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized data access via shared filesystem exposure.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Authorization controls limiting access to shared HPC storage resources.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforce approved access to shared HPC data.
Least privilege applied to storage access.

components.title: Job Data Isolation
components.description: Separates data used or produced by concurrent HPC jobs.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Data transfer or leakage through shared storage or intermediate buffers.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Logical separation of job‑scoped data within shared storage systems.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protection between job‑scoped data domains.
Information flow controls preventing cross‑job data leakage.

components.title: Data Lifecycle and Residual Risk Management
components.description: Manages data persistence, cleanup, and residual risk after HPC job completion.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Residual data exposure following job completion or reuse of storage.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controlled retention, cleanup, and protection of HPC data artifacts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Controlled removal and sanitization of temporary storage.
Integrity protection for data throughout its lifecycle.
